The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```java
Class<?> klass = actionConf.getClass(LauncherMapper.CONF_OOZIE_ACTION_MAIN_CLASS,
        org.apache.hadoop.tools.DistCp.class);
...
Tool distcp = (Tool) construct.newInstance(constArgs);
int i = distcp.run(args);
```
Reason:
The `DistcpMain` class does not utilize `ToolRunner` to handle command-line arguments, specifically the `-D` option, which is essential for setting Hadoop configuration properties. This oversight causes the Distcp action to fail when users attempt to specify configuration options via the `-D` flag.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```java
import org.apache.hadoop.util.ToolRunner;
...
int i = ToolRunner.run(distcp, args);
```
Reason:
By replacing `distcp.run(args)` with `ToolRunner.run(distcp, args)`, the patch ensures that the `-D` option and other command-line arguments are correctly processed, allowing the Distcp action to function as intended when configuration options are specified.
